 Order

This Criminal Original Petition has been filed to direct the learned Judicial Magistrate No.II,
Sivagangai to expedite the trial in C.C.No.129 of 2019 (Crime no.23 of 2013 on the file of the 1st Respondent Police 2.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, the learned Government Advocate(Crl.Side) appearing for the respondent police and perused the materials available on record.
3.The case of prosecution is that the accused persons induced the petitioner to invest amount in a land.
Believing their words, the petitioner paid a sum of Rs.10 lakhs as advance and a sum of Rs.3 lakhs to convert the said land as house plots.
Again the first accused demanded a sum of Rs.5 lakhs to get No Objection Certificate.
However, the petitioner refused to give the said amount and requested them to return back the amount.
The accused persons promised to return back the amount, however, they failed to do so.
Hence, the petitioner has lodged the said complaint.

The respondent police has registered a case in Cr.No.23 of 2013 for the offence punishable under Sections 467, 468, 471, 420 and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 120(B) IPC against the accused persons / private respondents.

After conducting investigation, the respondent police filed a final report before the concerned Court and the same was taken on file in C.C.No.129 of 2019 on the file of Judicial Magistrate No.II, Sivagangai.
In this case, after examination of the petitioner/PW1, it has been adjourned periodically without any valid reason.
Hence, seeking speedy trial this petition has been filed.
4.The learned Government Advocate (Crl.Side) submitted that in this case, after completion of investigation, final report was filed before the concerned Court on 07.06.2014.
However, the same was taken on file only on 07.03.2019.
There are totally 11 witnesses in this case.
Due to covid-19, the case has been adjourned periodically.

After framing of charges, though PW1 was examined in chief,
he was not cross- examined by the accused persons.
The witnesses are belongs to the same area and the respondent police will produced them without any delay.
The respondent police would take effective steps to conclude the trial within a stipulated period fixed by this Court.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
5.It is seen from the records that the occurrence took place in the year 2013 and after filing of final report in the year 2014, case was taken up on file only in the year 2019.
Till now, only PW1 was examined and the case was posted for cross-examination of PW1 today (ie., 09.01.2025).
The case has been adjourned periodically for one reason or other.

6.Considering the averments made on either side and the long pendency of the case from the year 2013, the respondent police is directed to produce the witnesses before the trial Court without any delay and assist the Court to complete the trial process.

The trial Court is directed to dispose of the case in CC No.129 of 2019 preferably, within a period of nine months from the date of receipt of L.Meganathan vs The State Of Tamilnadu on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102189323/
2 copy of this order.
